text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Namibian meat industry is still losing million of dollars because of cancelled business deals with South Africa, after stringent new export requirements were imposed last month.
- The government has suspended quotas for fishing companies still in arrears with payment of their quota fees. Fishing companies owe the government a total of N$18 million.
- Unleaded fuel will be introduced in Namibia only from the middle of next year after it has been decided that only one instead of two different fuel types are to be made available.
- Fishing companies still owe the Ministry of Fishery millions of dollars.
